# UwenzAi

> UwenzAi is an AI service provider with two core offerings, built for East African users and accessible worldwide at https://uwenzai.com. Its flagship product is an AI companion platform: emotionally intelligent, multilingual (English and Kiswahili/Sheng) AI companions with memory, relationship tracking, real-time web search, scheduled reminders, and culturally aware conversations. Alongside it, UwenzAi operates an AI API gateway for developers: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://agent-api.uwenzai.com/api/v1 that routes requests to multiple AI providers and meters usage in Sparks. UwenzAi is operated by UwenzAi Limited, a company registered in Kenya in 2026.

UwenzAi is developed in Kenya and Switzerland and is headquartered in Kenya. Both offerings are designed with East African culture, language, and social context at their core. Data privacy and security are core pillars of the platform: personal data such as email addresses and phone numbers is encrypted at rest, and UwenzAi uses European-based infrastructure to ensure GDPR-compliant data handling. Payments across both offerings run on the shared Spark system — standard options such as credit cards plus mobile money (M-Pesa and Airtel Money) — so companion messages and API usage draw on the same prepaid balance.

## AI Companions

The companion platform lets users chat as guests or register for a full account with a Spark-based messaging system, create their own characters, and generate custom images of their companions. Companions can optionally search the live web for current facts, news, and prices during a conversation, and can read a specific page a user shares. Users can also ask a companion to schedule personal reminders, which are delivered as chat messages at the chosen time and can be edited or cancelled at any point. The app can be installed as a Progressive Web App with push notifications for new messages, and users can choose between faster and deeper AI reasoning per conversation. Users can also bring their own API key (BYOK) to use third-party AI models at a reduced Spark cost. All AI characters are fictional adults; the platform is intended for users aged 18 and older, as it includes NSFW features.

## AI API for Developers

For developers, UwenzAi offers an OpenAI-compatible API gateway at https://agent-api.uwenzai.com/api/v1. Requests are routed to multiple AI providers with per-model pricing, usage is metered in Sparks, and everything is managed from the developer console at https://uwenzai.com/uwenzai-dev, where API keys, usage, and model prices can be viewed. Existing OpenAI SDKs and tools work unchanged by pointing the base URL at the gateway.

---

> UwenzAi ni mtoa huduma wa AI wenye bidhaa mbili kuu, lililojengwa kwa ajili ya watumiaji wa Afrika Mashariki na linapatikana duniani kote kupitia https://uwenzai.com. Bidhaa yake kuu ni jukwaa la AI companion: washirika wa AI wenye akili ya kihisia, wanaozungumza lugha nyingi (Kiingereza na Kiswahili/Sheng), wenye kumbukumbu, ufuatiliaji wa mahusiano, uwezo wa kutafuta taarifa mtandaoni kwa wakati halisi, vikumbusho vilivyopangwa, na mazungumzo yanayoendana na utamaduni wa eneo husika. Pamoja na hayo, UwenzAi inaendesha lango la API la AI kwa watengenezaji: mwisho wa API unaoilingana na OpenAI kwenye https://agent-api.uwenzai.com/api/v1 unaopeleka maombi kwa watoa huduma wengi wa AI na kupima matumizi kwa Sparks. UwenzAi inaendeshwa na UwenzAi Limited, kampuni iliyosajiliwa nchini Kenya mwaka 2026.

UwenzAi imetengenezwa nchini Kenya na Uswisi na ina makao yake makuu Kenya. Bidhaa zote mbili zimeundwa kwa kuzingatia utamaduni, lugha, na muktadha wa kijamii wa Afrika Mashariki. Faragha na usalama wa data ni nguzo kuu za jukwaa hili: taarifa binafsi kama barua pepe na namba za simu husimbwa zinapohifadhiwa, na UwenzAi hutumia miundombinu iliyoko Ulaya ili kuhakikisha utunzaji wa data unaozingatia kanuni za GDPR. Malipo kwa bidhaa zote mbili yanatumia mfumo mmoja wa Sparks — chaguzi za kawaida kama kadi za benki pamoja na fedha za simu (M-Pesa na Airtel Money) — hivyo ujumbe wa companion na matumizi ya API yanatokana na salio moja la malipo ya awali.

## Washirika wa AI

Jukwaa la companion linawaruhusu watumiaji kuzungumza kama wageni au kujisajili kwa akaunti kamili yenye mfumo wa ujumbe unaotumia Sparks, kuunda wahusika wao wenyewe, na kutengeneza picha maalum za washirika wao. Washirika wanaweza kutafuta taarifa mtandaoni kwa wakati halisi (habari, bei, matukio ya sasa) wakati wa mazungumzo, na kusoma ukurasa mahususi ambao mtumiaji ameshiriki. Watumiaji pia wanaweza uombe mwandani wao wa AI awawekee vikumbusho vya binafsi, ambavyo hutumwa kama ujumbe wa mazungumzo wakati ulioteuliwa, na vinaweza kuhaririwa au kughairiwa wakati wowote. Programu inaweza kusakinishwa kama Programu ya Wavuti Inayoendelea (PWA) yenye arifa za haraka za ujumbe mpya, na watumiaji wanaweza kuchagua kati ya majibu ya haraka au ya kina zaidi ya AI kwa kila mazungumzo. Watumiaji pia wanaweza kuleta ufunguo wao wa API (BYOK) ili kutumia mifano ya AI ya watu wengine kwa gharama ndogo ya Sparks. Wahusika wote wa AI ni watu wazima wa kubuni; jukwaa linalenga watumiaji wenye umri wa miaka 18 na zaidi, kwa kuwa lina vipengele vya NSFW.

## API ya AI kwa Watengenezaji

Kwa watengenezaji wa programu, UwenzAi inatoa lango la API linalolingana na OpenAI kwenye https://agent-api.uwenzai.com/api/v1. Maombi yanapelekwa kwa watoa huduma wengi wa AI wenye bei kwa kila modeli, matumizi yanapimwa kwa Sparks, na kila kitu kinadhibitiwa kutoka kwenye dashibodi ya watengenezaji kwenye https://uwenzai.com/uwenzai-dev, ambapo funguo za API, matumizi, na bei za mifano zinaweza kuangaliwa. SDK na zana zilizopo za OpenAI zinaendelea kufanya kazi bila mabadiliko kwa kuelekeza base URL kwenye lango hili.

- [Privacy Policy](https://uwenzai.com/privacy): What data is collected, how conversations and memory facts are stored, and user rights
- [Responsible Use Guide](https://uwenzai.com/responsible-use): Community standards, content boundaries, and BYOK policy
- [Subprocessor Disclosure](https://uwenzai.com/subprocessors): Third-party infrastructure and processors used to run the platform
- [Developer API Documentation](https://uwenzai.com/uwenzai-dev/docs/): Bilingual (English/Kiswahili) API reference for the OpenAI-compatible gateway — authentication, endpoints, pricing in Sparks, error codes, and rate limits

## Product

- [Homepage](https://uwenzai.com): Main entry point — guest chat access, character discovery, sign-up
- [Characters](https://uwenzai.com/characters): Browse available AI companion characters (public listing)
- [Pricing / Spark Pool](https://uwenzai.com/spark_pool): Spark packages, pricing in KES and other currencies, Paystack payment integration, M-Pesa and Airtel Money support
- [UwenzAi API / Developer Console](https://uwenzai.com/uwenzai-dev): OpenAI-compatible AI gateway at https://agent-api.uwenzai.com/api/v1 — bring your own `uwenzai-dev-...` API key, usage metered in Sparks with per-model pricing
